name: Reclaimarr
description: A tool to automatically reclaim disk space on your media server by intelligently deleting content from Jellyfin, Sonarr, and Radarr based on watch history and age.

variables.name: Jellyfin - URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellyfin server (e.g., http://jellyfin.local:8096)

variables.name: Jellystat - URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellystat server (e.g., http://jellystat.local:port)

variables.name: Jellyseerr - URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellyseerr server (e.g., http://jellyseerr.local:port)

variables.name: Radarr - URL
variables.description: URL of your Radarr server (e.g., http://radarr.local:7878)

variables.name: Sonarr - URL
variables.description: URL of your Sonarr server (e.g., http://sonarr.local:8989)

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for when to run the reclaim process

variables.name: Minimum File Age (Days)
variables.description: The minimum age in days before a media item can be deleted.

variables.name: Dry Run
variables.description: If true, no files will actually be deleted.

variables.name: Verbose Logging
variables.description: If true, verbose logging will be enabled.

variables.name: Internal Media Path
variables.description: Internal path to your media files. Not recommended to change.
